title: Delete an appointment
summary: Delete an appointment entered by mistake (not the same as canceling it).

steps.title: Menu → Appointments
steps.details: The calendar shows appointments by room and doctor.

steps.title: Right-click the appointment
steps.details: The appointment menu opens. If you don't see it, change the day with the arrows or use Find appointment.

steps.title: Delete appointment
steps.details: For appointments entered by mistake. If the patient isn't coming, cancel it with its reason: that way it shows in the reports.
